links.outcome: Retention of a passing-mentioned allergy under KV-cache compression, with question hidden versus known
links.effect: When the question is hidden until after compression, a passing allergy mention survives 0-1% of the time versus 97% with full memory; prior benchmarks report retention at a 20% budget.
links.quote: Hide the question until after compression and the advantage vanishes: on PA-Bench, 100 assistant conversations we construct, an allergy mentioned in passing survives to the question that needs it 0--1% of the time, against 97% with full memory.

links.outcome: Loss of safety-critical facts when conversation memory is compressed or truncated
links.effect: Training-free eviction policies fail to rank the allergy fact highly enough; allergy survives 0-1% of the time versus 97% with full memory, and the budget needed to keep it is too large to be worth compressing.
